items.description: Cart Panic! OS is not just a tycoon game. It's a fully functional operating system where you run an online store while hackers attack you, viruses pop up, customers rage in chat, and a high-stakes card game tempts you to gamble your profits away.You start with $50, an ugly desktop, and your first debt. Your store has zero reviews. Your first supplier is already late. Then everything happens at once.Your Desktop, Your BusinessThis isn't a menu-based tycoon. Every system runs through apps on your desktop. Drag windows, multitask between crises, and watch your taskbar fill up as chaos escalates.19 functional apps - Dashboard, Analytics, Marketing, Finance, Employees, Hacking Terminal, Antivirus, MetaStack card game, and moreReal window management - Minimize, resize, stack, and juggle multiple windows as orders pile upPersistent threats - Viruses spawn randomly, slow your system, corrupt data, and demand ransomRun Your StoreBuild your e-commerce business from scratch. Design your storefront, negotiate with suppliers, fulfill orders, and survive the constant pressure of unhappy customers.Website Studio - Design your store with layouts, themes, colors and fonts. Your design choices affect conversion ratesSupply Hub - Manage inventory, browse suppliers, negotiate prices and delivery times. Cheap suppliers create defectsCustomer Chat - Answer questions, handle complaints, process refunds. One wrong reply can tank your reputationMarketing Campaigns - Launch ads, track ROI, and watch your budget burn as algorithms changeHackOS TerminalA full hacking simulator built into the game. Open the terminal, type real commands, and attack targets for massive payouts. Or defend against incoming threats.Functional CLI - Navigate directories, run commands, autocomplete, command history5 hacking minigames - Password cracking, firewall defense, encryption races, network mazes, packet sniffingMultiple targets - From easy marks to extreme difficulty, with risk and reward to matchAttack & defend - Launch operations or protect your own systems from incoming breachesMetaStack: Wager OpsA Balatro-inspired roguelike card game hidden inside your desktop. Play poker hands, build combos, collect patches and plugins, and bet real in-game money against escalating contracts.Poker roguelike - Play hands from High Card to Five of a Kind, draft upgrades between roundsReal stakes - Wager your actual profits. Win big or lose everythingHype system - Build multipliers with consecutive wins, up to 10x4 difficulty tiers - Safe, Medium, High, Extreme. Payouts scale from 1x to 10xOverclock mechanic - Risk instant multipliers with increasing dangerManage Everything ElseEmployees - Hire staff, train skills, manage salaries, fire underperformersFinance - Track cash flow, take loans, pay taxes, avoid bankruptcyInvestments - Long-term portfolios or arcade-style day trading with stop-loss and take-profitAnalytics - Sales funnels, customer satisfaction, top products, performance over timeAntivirus - Scan threats, quarantine malware, enable real-time protection100+ upgrades - Eight upgrade branches: Storefront, Logistics, Payments, Marketing, Infrastructure, Expansion, Hacking, SecurityChaos is the CoreThere is no pause button for the pressure. Customers don't wait. Viruses don't care about your cash flow. Your best employee might quit while you're mid-hack and a refund storm is brewing in chat.Every session is different. Every decision has trade-offs. Every system affects every other system.Build your empire. Or watch it crash. items.description: High school teacher Yukio fell asleep at the end of the day, really like any other day... but this time it was different, the air was cold, the sky turned red, everything was dark and strange whispers were heard. steps... many things have changed. Everything seemed like a nightmare until he realized that he had woken up, and while he was dreaming he heard a warning: "I'm going to devour you human beings, if you can't escape, light the twelve lamps of the monster dimension and escape" Then the young professor understood that if he couldn't escape, he would be devoured.Puzzles, scares and strange creatures await you at the institute! {STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/icono2048__13_.pngTerror in the environment: Yakyosho generates scares and moments of tension with the help of the environment and sounds. In the institute you can expect different mechanics, terrifying creatures and guaranteed scares. Puzzles: Different mechanics to help you escape and force you to explore the whole environment, light and simple, but recurring, they can be complex so there is a guide in the menu, complete them to give you a little help while trying to complete the main mission. items.description: A 2D fast-paced platformer with action elements and cartoon-style graphics. As a Reptilian, you must traverse numerous levels, avoid traps, and battle enemies along the way. Your goal is to rescue your fellow tribesmen and defeat the evil corporation that seeks to enslave your home planet!StoryOn a distant planet at the edge of the galaxy, a friendly reptilian race lived in peace. Everything was perfect until suddenly, humans from Astra Chemical Corp arrived. The corporation began mining an acid-rich mineral used as an energy source for industrial production and interstellar travel. The Reptilians were enslaved and forced to work in the mines. However, mining soon became difficult and expensive. The corporation then found another solution—extracting acid directly from the Reptilians, as their bodies consist of 95% acid.One brave Reptilian discovered the corporation's sinister plans and decided to stop them at any cost and save his people from extinction!GameplayThe Reptilian can run, jump, dash, wall-kick, and climb on walls and ceilings. He can attack using claws and his tail, spit acid, and bite. Using all these abilities, you must explore levels, overcome obstacles, and avoid traps. Each level presents small challenges: find and collect all batteries, which serve as keys to doors, or defeat enemies and rescue your trapped friends. You can choose your own approach to dealing with the sinister corporation’s soldiers—jump down from the ceiling using stealth or engage them head-on with claws or acid attacks.Local Co-op for Two PlayersGame Features:An engaging setting and agile main characterCartoon-style graphics and animations, including animated cutscenesDynamic visual effectsThree difficulty levelsAtmospheric soundtrackLocal multiplayer for two players Subscribe to our newsletter Get STEAM deals and FREE games in your inbox Game developers Want your game sold on DailyIndieGame? items.description: Give them hellYour name is Jackson. Captain Jackson. You are caught in the middle of war between humans and Rivanirs - an alien species from another star system. As an Elite Pilot you must face the wrath of the Rivanirs' Fleet. Your commanding officer explains the battle plans but you don't care. You just want to face the hordes of those monsters on your own. You leave the flag ship in your trusted green star fighter and head straight for the aliens' fleet. They will give you everything they've got but you know your life led to this very moment. You are well prepared. You... are Captain Jackson.What's it all about?After that cool story depiction let's talk about what "Captain Jackson" really is. It's a 2D retro, pixel-art, shooter where your goal is to get the highest score you can achieve. On your way of extermination you can find and use several power ups, that will buff certain aspects of your ship. Additionaly after battles you will receive a currency which can be used to buy variety of skins for your starship. Moreover there is a suprise waiting for you after you complete the game.
